meta.title: Palestra Azzurra · Follonica
meta.description: Palestra Azzurra is a wellness institution in Follonica. 200m from the sea: a weights floor with Technogym, Toorx, Panatta and Sidea equipment, a group-class studio and Azzurra Lab, the first personal training studio in Follonica.

hero.title: Palestra Azzurra
hero.sub: Reach your goals in the most effective way.
hero.coach: Get coached by a Health Coach!
hero.photoAlt: The Palestra Azzurra staff on the gym floor

about.title: Palestra Azzurra is a wellness institution in Follonica
about.challenge: to be an active part of your journey towards a healthier shape and lifestyle, supporting you with total commitment and professionalism as you reach your goals.
about.body: Just 200m from the sea, you’ll find a large weights floor with Technogym, Toorx, Panatta and Sidea equipment, a spacious class studio and an equipped outdoor area. You’ll always be followed by a highly qualified instructor and you’ll never feel alone. We’ll welcome you at our completely renovated reception.
about.photoAlt: Kettlebell training on the weights floor

motto.title: Movement is life
motto.body: A healthy lifestyle combined with proper training is fundamental to us. The body is a machine, and like any machine it needs the perfect pairing to run:
motto.after: That’s why our centre offers a wide variety of services and activities, and we’ll help you choose them based on the goals we set together.

lab.born: The first personal training studio in Follonica
lab.title: Azzurra Lab is the answer!!
lab.key: Training consistently and eating right is the key to success!!
lab.quote: We cannot expect things to change… if we keep doing the same things

gallery.floor: Bodyweight training on the weights floor

staff.title: The Staff
staff.lead: Our staff’s strength is support and professionalism
staff.team: Our team is made up of highly specialised professionals.
staff.p1: Our team will welcome you and meet your every need: we start with a careful assessment of your situation, then write a personalised programme for you to follow on the floor, always under our supervision.
staff.p2: We’ll never leave you alone, and we’ll walk you through the explanation and execution of every single exercise.
staff.p3: “YOUR” programme will be reviewed and changed several times a year, so that together we can reach your goals, and of course ours too.
staff.teamAlt: Training on the gym floor with our staff

credentials: Diploma in Sports Nutrition and Supplementation
Degree in Sport and Physical Activity Management
League Instructor qualification, UISP Weightlifting and Physical Culture.
Teaching certification. Basic Motor Activity, CONI Youth Sector.
FIF-ASI-CONI Fitness and Bodybuilding Instructor diploma
